Mr. Arindam Jana, Adv.

Mr. Soumajit Chatterjee, Adv.
Ms. Purbali Dutta, Adv.
Mr. Arhan Sengupta, Adv.
...for the petitioner.

The Branch Manager of a non-Banking Financial Institution under the name and style of Fullerton
India Credit Company Limited has filed the instant revision praying for quashing of the proceeding
being G.R. Case No.6509 of 2022 arising out of Malda Police Station Case No.473 of 2022 dated
16th October, 2022 under Sections 406/420/465/467/468/471/34 of the Indian Penal Code
presently pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Malda.

entities.text: Branch Manager of a non-Banking Financial Institution
entities.label: RESPONDENT

entities.text: Malda Police Station Case No.473 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
The case of the de-facto complainant/opposite party No.2 is that sometimes in the month of April,
2022, he met one person named Biswajit Sarkar who identified himself as the person helping the intending borrowers to obtain loan from various banks and non-Banking Financial Institutions.
The opposite party No.2 is a Medical Practitioner having a nursing home at Malda.
He required loan of Rs.2,00,000,00/- (Rupees Two Crore) and approached the said Biswajit Sarkar to arrange for such loan.
According to the FIR, Biswajit made arrangement for loan of various amounts from ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Bajaj Financial Corporation and Fullerton India Credit Company Limited.
It is alleged by the opposite party No.2 that he and his wife never went to the office of any bank or non-Banking Financial Institutions.

Everything was done by the said Biswajit Sarkar and Biswajit told the rate of interest payable by the opposite party No.2 but, subsequently, after getting the loan and paying two EMI's he understood that the interest amount charged by the banks and other Financial Institutions are higher than which was disclosed by Biswajit.

Therefore, the Branch Ashim Das vs State Of West Bengal & Anr on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123986403/
1 Manager of Fullerton India Credit Company Limited has been made an accused.

entities.text: Branch Ashim Das vs State Of West Bengal & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by Mr. Jana, learned Advocate for the petitioner that Fullerton India Credit Company Limited issued loan to the petitioner pursuant to his application which was duly submitted by the de-facto complainant.
Before disbursement of money, a letter was sent to the opposite party No.2 stating the sanction of loan and the rate of interest to be paid by the opposite party No.2.
The opposite party No.2 acted on the basis of an assurance by one Biswajit Sarkar who is not an employee of Fullerton India Credit Company Limited.
The communication between Biswajit Sarkar and opposite party No.2 does not bind the petitioner.
Thus, there is every reason to admit the instant revision.
Accordingly, the instant revision is admitted.
Petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party and file affidavit of service within three weeks from the date of this order.
The State of West Bengal be served through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.
In the meantime, further proceedings of G.R. Case No.6509 of 2022 be stayed as against the present petitioner for a period of six weeks.
( Bibek Chaudhuri, J. )
